attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a single RabbitMQ 4.3.5 cluster (Erlang 27.3.4.17), created the `payments` vhost with an app user `payments_app` granted full permissions, and a durable quorum queue `orders` replicated across all three nodes. Verified messages published to the queue survive the loss of the leader node and remain consumable from a surviving node. Completed the mandatory sequential restart of all three nodes with boot-id-verified reboots and post-restart cluster/queue health checks.
